name: EdgeMemBench
description: Repository-local evaluation set for memory admission, retrieval, update handling, and abstention.

admission.A: Run the actual memory admission decision.
admission.B-D: Bypass admission and inject every user turn as an existing memory observation.

B.hit_at_k: Success when any gold evidence appears in top K.
B.recall_at_k: Fraction of all gold evidence recovered in top K.

C.scoring_policy: Use the manually reviewed target/competing/context partition. Excluded source-contract cases remain in artifacts but do not contribute to aggregate scores.
C.known_baseline_limitation: The current product memory prompt does not expose timestamps to the reader.

D.threshold_policy: Do not select or tune an operating threshold on the v0 test set.

storage_decision_normalized.name: EdgeMemBench v0 normalized storage decision set

temporal_view_contract.name: EdgeMemBench cohort-local temporal view derivation contract
temporal_view_contract.annotation_method: Deterministic mapping from the manually reviewed C subtypes, with one explicit strict as-of override

cohort_pair_annotations.name: EdgeMemBench GPT-5.6-sol double-blind cohort-pair annotations
cohort_pair_annotations.annotation_method: two independent labels, blind third-vote adjudication, and an optional fresh fourth-vote tiebreak

cohort_abc_candidate_annotations.name: EdgeMemBench GPT-5.6-sol A/B/C candidate supplement
cohort_abc_candidate_annotations.annotation_method: two independent labels with blind third-vote adjudication

cohort_delta_calibration.name: PetAI Korean temporal-cohort delta calibration v1
cohort_delta_calibration.annotation_method: manually authored deterministic same-attribute and hard-negative pairs

longmemeval_s_cleaned.name: LongMemEval-S cleaned
longmemeval_s_cleaned.citation: Wu et al., LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory, ICLR 2025
